title: The end-of-month option in futures contracts and the Gittins index of holding the underlying
abstract: arXiv:2610.21196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The end-of-month option allows the short in a futures contract to choose when to deliver during a window in which the delivery price is fixed. We characterize optimal delivery through a universal index obtained from the Bank--El Karoui representation theorem. In the semimartingale setting, this is the Gittins index of holding the underlying and collecting its convenience yield, and the futures price is the retirement reward for which the value of this project equals the spot price. This characterization yields price bounds and a criterion for immediate delivery. Dinkelbach's iteration reduces the price computation to a sequence of standard optimal stopping problems, with an explicit contraction bound. We apply the theory to geometric Brownian motion and the Gibson--Schwartz model with stochastic convenience yield. translated_title: 期货合约中的月末交割期权与持有标的资产的基特金斯指数
translated_abstract: 月末交割期权允许期货合约的空头方在交割价格固定的窗口期内选择何时进行交割。我们通过由Bank–El Karoui表示定理得到的通用指数来刻画最优交割策略。在半鞅框架下，该指数即为持有标的资产并收取其便利收益的基特金斯指数，而期货价格则是使该项目的价值等于现货价格的退休回报。这一刻画给出了价格边界以及立即交割的判据。Dinkelbach迭代将价格计算归结为一系列标准的最优停时问题，并给出了显式的压缩界。我们将该理论应用于几何布朗运动以及具有随机便利收益的Gibson–Schwartz模型。对于几何布朗运动，我们刻画了期货价格何时等于现货价格，并推导出平方根形式的边界渐近性质。
tldr: 本文利用Bank–El Karoui表示定理将期货合约的月末交割期权刻画为持有标的资产并收取便利收益的基特金斯指数问题，期货价格即为使该项目价值等于现货价格的退休回报，并通过Dinkelbach迭代将定价计算化归为一系列标准的最优停时问题。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the end-of-month option in futures contracts as a Gittins index problem of holding the underlying and collecting its convenience yield via the Bank–El Karoui representation theorem, identifies the futures price as the retirement reward equalizing project value and spot price, and reduces pricing to a sequence of standard optimal stopping problems through Dinkelbach's iteration.
